title: City Council District 6
statement: District 6 is maintaining disciplined oversight over our neighborhood baselines on Piedmont Avenue, supporting vital community anchors like B'nai Tikvah Synagogue while keeping our legislative docket clear this cycle. When it comes to citywide health and workforce programs, my responsibility is to examine the accounting records and audit deliverables independently, not to rubber-stamp caucus directives.

payload.text: District 6 will not sponsor caucus-driven oversight motions as a factional bloc. While I demand complete fiscal audits and verified accounting for the Temescal Health Center and the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline, I evaluate those parameters through formal committee proceedings on their merits rather than through partisan filings.
